methods.source: Pure statistical functions are defined inline in this notebook.
methods.round_correctness: delphi_consensus_selected_option, not winner_selected_option; invalid decisions count wrong at panel level.
methods.contested: delphi_rounds_executed >= 2; R1 plurality, organizer tie-break, confidence fallback.
methods.unanimity: Legacy r1_unanimous column counts stopped after R1. Use r1_unanimous_three_valid for strict unanimity; pipeline can stop on concordant valid answers when one slot is missing.
methods.paired_test: Two-sided exact McNemar on discordant questions.
methods.round_multiplicity: Holm across 30 panel-subset contested-round tests; sensitivity Holm across 5 subsets within each panel.
methods.individual_pairs: Only valid at R1 and last executed round; 10,000 whole-question paired-correctness-ratio bootstrap, seed 20261011.
methods.individual_p: Pooled expert-decision exact p is nominal and not cluster-adjusted; do not use as independent confirmatory evidence.
methods.stage_cohorts: R1/R2/R3 compared on the same actually-3-round questions; separately R1/R2 for actually-2-round questions. Descriptive stage p values unadjusted.
methods.first_round_controls: Within-panel independently sampled R1 decisions; homogeneous slots remain distinct. Each control has a separate Holm family of 30 tests.
methods.influence: Only valid 2-vs-1 initial splits among contested questions; descriptive alignment with initial majority by initial majority correctness; whole-question CIs.
methods.no_pooling: Five overlapping subsets are never pooled into one accuracy or one independent significance test.
